people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.
translations.bsb: This response made the king so angry and furious that he gave orders to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
